title: STEP 超臨界二氧化碳示範電廠
subcategoryTitleEn: Power cycles and combined heat and power
summary: 德州聖安東尼奧的 STEP 示範電廠是目前世界上最大的間接加熱式超臨界二氧化碳試驗設施，設計出力十 MW、渦輪進口溫度七百一十五度。它在 2023 年完成機械安裝，2024 年以簡單循環首次發電，之後再改成效率更高的再壓縮循環。它的任務是證明這種循環在接近商用的規模下可以穩定運轉。課程定量分析高速轉子的葉尖速度、提高溫度的效率增益、乾氣密封的洩漏與放大後的單位成本。
summaryEn: STEP Demo in San Antonio, Texas, is the largest indirectly heated supercritical carbon dioxide test facility in the world, designed for ten megawatts at a turbine inlet of 715 degrees. Mechanically complete in 2023, it first generated in 2024 on a simple cycle, to be reconfigured as the more efficient recompression cycle. Its task is to show the cycle runs steadily at near-commercial scale. The course quantifies tip speed of the fast rotor, efficiency gained with temperature, leakage of dry gas seals and unit cost at scale.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與標準架構編寫的原創教學。步驟是可驗證的分析、估算與檢核任務，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、運轉程序或作業許可。核能內容僅限公開的熱循環、功能架構、土木與安全理念，不包含燃料製備、濃縮、再處理、武器、反應度整定、反應爐操作或保安細節。數值為公開標稱值或教學假設，實際工程須由合格專業人員依規範與實測資料重新計算並負責。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and standards frameworks. Steps are verifiable analysis, estimation and checking tasks, not drawings, method statements, operating procedures or permits. Nuclear content is limited to public thermal cycles, functional architecture, civil works and safety concepts and excludes fuel production, enrichment, reprocessing, weapons, reactivity settings, reactor operation and security details. Numbers are public nominal values or teaching assumptions; real work must be recalculated by qualified professionals using codes and measured data.

nodes: Generator and power or heat network

v30Focus: 把實驗室的循環放大成十 MW 的電廠：轉子的葉尖速度、溫度與效率的增益、密封洩漏與放大的成本
v30FocusEn: Scaling a laboratory cycle to a ten-megawatt plant: rotor tip speed, efficiency gained with temperature, seal leakage and the cost of scale

stages.title: 資源、需求與系統架構：STEP 超臨界二氧化碳示範電廠
stages.titleEn: Resource, demand and system architecture: STEP Supercritical CO2 Demonstration Plant
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「熱源溫度與卡諾上限」與「渦輪排氣溫度與回熱的必要」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Source temperature and the Carnot ceiling" and "Turbine exhaust temperature and the need to recuperate": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

quiz.question: 關於「熱源溫度與卡諾上限」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Source temperature and the Carnot ceiling" is correct?
options: 熱機把熱轉成功的比例受熱力學第二定律限制，上限只取決於吸熱與排熱的絕對溫度。
只要機器做得夠精密，熱機效率可以接近百分之百。
氣體通過渦輪機之後就變冷了。
optionsEn: The share of heat a heat engine can turn into work is limited by the second law to a ceiling depending only on the absolute temperatures at which heat is taken in and rejected.
With precise enough machinery, heat-engine efficiency can approach 100%.
Gas is cold once it has passed through a turbine.
quiz.explanation: 熱機把熱轉成功的比例受熱力學第二定律限制，上限只取決於吸熱與排熱的絕對溫度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The share of heat a heat engine can turn into work is limited by the second law to a ceiling depending only on the absolute temperatures at which heat is taken in and rejected. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 熱源溫度與卡諾上限：機制與能量路徑
steps.titleEn: Source temperature and the Carnot ceiling: mechanism and energy path
steps.objective: 說明「熱源溫度與卡諾上限」如何決定「STEP 超臨界二氧化碳示範電廠」的能量轉換、輸送、儲存或安全功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Source temperature and the Carnot ceiling” governs energy conversion, transfer, storage or safety functions in “STEP Supercritical CO2 Demonstration Plant”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 熱機把熱轉成功的比例受熱力學第二定律限制，上限只取決於吸熱與排熱的絕對溫度。提高效率因此只有兩條路：提高熱源溫度，或降低排熱溫度。燃氣渦輪的進口溫度已超過 1,500 °C，遠高於葉片合金的熔點，靠的是氣膜冷卻與陶瓷熱障塗層；蒸汽循環則以超臨界參數與多次再熱提高平均吸熱溫度。實際效率與卡諾上限的差距，來自壓縮、膨脹、傳熱與燃燒等不可逆過程。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The share of heat a heat engine can turn into work is limited by the second law to a ceiling depending only on the absolute temperatures at which heat is taken in and rejected. Efficiency therefore improves only by raising source temperature or lowering rejection temperature. Gas-turbine inlet temperatures now exceed 1,500 °C, far above the melting point of blade alloys, thanks to film cooling and ceramic thermal-barrier coatings, while steam cycles raise mean heat-addition temperature with supercritical conditions and reheating. The gap between real efficiency and Carnot comes from irreversibility in compression, expansion, heat transfer and combustion. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 工程檔案：設計出力為 10 MW
steps.observationEn: Project file: Design output is 10 MW
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要機器做得夠精密，熱機效率可以接近百分之百。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在流程圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "With precise enough machinery, heat-engine efficiency can approach 100%." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your flow diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 流程圖標明「熱源溫度與卡諾上限」的輸入、轉換、損失與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The flow diagram shows inputs, conversions, losses and boundary for “Source temperature and the Carnot ceiling”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要機器做得夠精密，熱機效率可以接近百分之百。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: With precise enough machinery, heat-engine efficiency can approach 100%. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 工程檔案
knowledge.text: 設計出力為 10 MW
knowledge.textEn: Design output is 10 MW

quiz.question: 依「熱源溫度與卡諾上限」的模型 η_C = 1 − T_c / T_h，以渦輪進口溫度與環境溫度計算的卡諾上限最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model η_C = 1 − T_c / T_h for "Source temperature and the Carnot ceiling", which value is closest to the carnot ceiling from turbine inlet temperature and ambient temperature?
quiz.explanation: η_C = 1 − T_c / T_h；代入 Tc = 35 °C、TIT = 715 °C，得 68.8 %（以渦輪進口溫度與環境溫度計算的卡諾上限）。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: η_C = 1 − T_c / T_h; with Tc = 35 °C, TIT = 715 °C the result is 68.8 % (carnot ceiling from turbine inlet temperature and ambient temperature). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 熱源溫度與卡諾上限：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Source temperature and the Carnot ceiling: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「熱源溫度與卡諾上限」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Source temperature and the Carnot ceiling” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：η_C = 1 − T_c / T_h；代入 Tc = 35 °C、TIT = 715 °C，得 68.8 %（以渦輪進口溫度與環境溫度計算的卡諾上限）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 TIT 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: η_C = 1 − T_c / T_h; with Tc = 35 °C, TIT = 715 °C the result is 68.8 % (carnot ceiling from turbine inlet temperature and ambient temperature). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise TIT by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：TIT 增加 10% 時，結果變為 70.9 %（+3.1%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising TIT by 10% changes the result to 70.9 % (+3.1%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 68.8 %（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 TIT 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 68.8 % (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in TIT with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: η_C = 1 − T_c / T_h；代入 Tc = 35 °C、TIT = 715 °C，得 68.8 %（以渦輪進口溫度與環境溫度計算的卡諾上限）。
knowledge.textEn: η_C = 1 − T_c / T_h; with Tc = 35 °C, TIT = 715 °C the result is 68.8 % (carnot ceiling from turbine inlet temperature and ambient temperature).

knowledge.title: 敏感度
knowledge.text: TIT 增加 10% 時，結果變為 70.9 %（+3.1%）。 先預測方向與次方，再用計算確認。
knowledge.textEn: Raising TIT by 10% changes the result to 70.9 % (+3.1%). Predict direction and exponent first, then confirm by calculation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為公開標稱值或教學假設的簡化；套用到實際設備前，必須依規範、製造商資料與現場量測重新計算。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are public nominal values or simplified teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, recalculate with codes, manufacturer data and site measurements.

quiz.question: 要驗證「熱源溫度與卡諾上限」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Source temperature and the Carnot ceiling"?
options: 量測時不必記錄環境溫度、負載與運轉模式，因為它們不影響結果。
不同電廠的效率數字可以直接比較，不必管用的是哪一種熱值。
依 ASME PTC 46 做全廠性能試驗：量測燃料流量與熱值、淨出力與環境條件，修正到合約基準後求得淨效率，並與設計熱平衡比較。
optionsEn: Ambient temperature, load and operating mode need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Efficiency figures from different plants can be compared directly, whichever heating value is used.

Run an overall plant performance test under ASME PTC 46: measure fuel flow and heating value, net output and ambient conditions, correct to contract reference conditions to obtain net efficiency, and compare with the design heat balance.
quiz.explanation: 依 ASME PTC 46 做全廠性能試驗：量測燃料流量與熱值、淨出力與環境條件，修正到合約基準後求得淨效率，並與設計熱平衡比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Run an overall plant performance test under ASME PTC 46: measure fuel flow and heating value, net output and ambient conditions, correct to contract reference conditions to obtain net efficiency, and compare with the design heat balance. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 熱源溫度與卡諾上限：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Source temperature and the Carnot ceiling: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「熱源溫度與卡諾上限」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Source temperature and the Carnot ceiling” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 依 ASME PTC 46 做全廠性能試驗：量測燃料流量與熱值、淨出力與環境條件，修正到合約基準後求得淨效率，並與設計熱平衡比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Run an overall plant performance test under ASME PTC 46: measure fuel flow and heating value, net output and ambient conditions, correct to contract reference conditions to obtain net efficiency, and compare with the design heat balance. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：性能保證要載明基準環境條件、燃料成分與退化修正曲線，並在大修前後各做一次性能試驗以量化回復量。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Performance guarantees should state reference ambient conditions, fuel composition and degradation-correction curves, with a test before and after each major overhaul to quantify recovery.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：壓縮機葉片積垢、渦輪葉尖間隙磨耗與進氣濾網壓降增加，使各部件效率下降，整廠效率每年退化零點幾個百分點。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Compressor fouling, turbine tip-clearance wear and rising inlet-filter pressure drop lower component efficiency, degrading plant efficiency by a few tenths of a percentage point each year. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 依 ASME PTC 46 做全廠性能試驗：量測燃料流量與熱值、淨出力與環境條件，修正到合約基準後求得淨效率，並與設計熱平衡比較。
knowledge.textEn: Run an overall plant performance test under ASME PTC 46: measure fuel flow and heating value, net output and ambient conditions, correct to contract reference conditions to obtain net efficiency, and compare with the design heat balance.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 性能保證要載明基準環境條件、燃料成分與退化修正曲線，並在大修前後各做一次性能試驗以量化回復量。
knowledge.textEn: Performance guarantees should state reference ambient conditions, fuel composition and degradation-correction curves, with a test before and after each major overhaul to quantify recovery.

knowledge.title: 規範與標準
knowledge.text: 可對照的公開規範或指引：ASME PTC 46 電廠整體性能試驗。引用時須確認版次與適用範圍。
knowledge.textEn: A public code or guide to compare against: ASME PTC 46 Overall Plant Performance. Confirm edition and applicability before citing it.

quiz.question: 在「熱源溫度與卡諾上限」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Source temperature and the Carnot ceiling" shows an anomaly, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 壓縮機葉片積垢、渦輪葉尖間隙磨耗與進氣濾網壓降增加，使各部件效率下降，整廠效率每年退化零點幾個百分點。
所有異常都是操作人員失誤，設計、製造與維護不需要檢討。
氣體通過渦輪機之後就變冷了。
optionsEn: Compressor fouling, turbine tip-clearance wear and rising inlet-filter pressure drop lower component efficiency, degrading plant efficiency by a few tenths of a percentage point each year.
Every anomaly is operator error, so design, manufacturing and maintenance never need review.
Gas is cold once it has passed through a turbine.
quiz.explanation: 壓縮機葉片積垢、渦輪葉尖間隙磨耗與進氣濾網壓降增加，使各部件效率下降，整廠效率每年退化零點幾個百分點。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Compressor fouling, turbine tip-clearance wear and rising inlet-filter pressure drop lower component efficiency, degrading plant efficiency by a few tenths of a percentage point each year. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 熱源溫度與卡諾上限：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Source temperature and the Carnot ceiling: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「熱源溫度與卡諾上限」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or degradation causes of “Source temperature and the Carnot ceiling” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 壓縮機葉片積垢、渦輪葉尖間隙磨耗與進氣濾網壓降增加，使各部件效率下降，整廠效率每年退化零點幾個百分點。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢查，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響「STEP 超臨界二氧化碳示範電廠」的安全、出力、壽命或併網。
steps.instructionEn: Compressor fouling, turbine tip-clearance wear and rising inlet-filter pressure drop lower component efficiency, degrading plant efficiency by a few tenths of a percentage point each year. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects safety, output, life or grid connection of “STEP Supercritical CO2 Demonstration Plant”.
steps.observation: 連結機制：實際效率與卡諾上限的差距，來自壓縮、膨脹、傳熱與燃燒等不可逆過程。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The gap between real efficiency and Carnot comes from irreversibility in compression, expansion, heat transfer and combustion.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要機器做得夠精密，熱機效率可以接近百分之百。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "With precise enough machinery, heat-engine efficiency can approach 100%." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢查能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 壓縮機葉片積垢、渦輪葉尖間隙磨耗與進氣濾網壓降增加，使各部件效率下降，整廠效率每年退化零點幾個百分點。
knowledge.textEn: Compressor fouling, turbine tip-clearance wear and rising inlet-filter pressure drop lower component efficiency, degrading plant efficiency by a few tenths of a percentage point each year.

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; swapping equipment, resetting alarms or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 關於「渦輪排氣溫度與回熱的必要」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Turbine exhaust temperature and the need to recuperate" is correct?
options: 氣體通過渦輪機之後就變冷了。
示範機組的問題在放大之後只會更嚴重。
二氧化碳在渦輪機裡由兩百五十個大氣壓膨脹到八十幾個大氣壓，壓力比只有三。
optionsEn: Gas is cold once it has passed through a turbine.
Problems of a demonstration unit only get worse at scale.
Carbon dioxide expands in the turbine from two hundred and fifty atmospheres to eighty-odd, a pressure ratio of only three.
quiz.explanation: 二氧化碳在渦輪機裡由兩百五十個大氣壓膨脹到八十幾個大氣壓，壓力比只有三。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Carbon dioxide expands in the turbine from two hundred and fifty atmospheres to eighty-odd, a pressure ratio of only three. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 渦輪排氣溫度與回熱的必要：機制與能量路徑
steps.titleEn: Turbine exhaust temperature and the need to recuperate: mechanism and energy path
steps.objective: 說明「渦輪排氣溫度與回熱的必要」如何決定「STEP 超臨界二氧化碳示範電廠」的能量轉換、輸送、儲存或安全功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Turbine exhaust temperature and the need to recuperate” governs energy conversion, transfer, storage or safety functions in “STEP Supercritical CO2 Demonstration Plant”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 二氧化碳在渦輪機裡由兩百五十個大氣壓膨脹到八十幾個大氣壓，壓力比只有三。壓力比這麼小，氣體降溫的幅度有限：進口七百一十五度，出口還有將近五百度。這股五百度的排氣如果直接送去冷卻，循環的效率只有兩成上下；所以它必須先經過回熱器，把熱交給正要進加熱器的高壓流體。示範廠第一階段的簡單回熱循環只有一級回熱器，第二階段的再壓縮循環則有高溫與低溫兩級——設備的更換與重新配管，本身就是試驗的一部分。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Carbon dioxide expands in the turbine from two hundred and fifty atmospheres to eighty-odd, a pressure ratio of only three. With so small a ratio the gas cools little: in at 715 degrees, it leaves at nearly five hundred. Sent straight to the cooler, that exhaust would leave the cycle about twenty percent efficient, so it first passes through a recuperator giving its heat to high-pressure fluid on its way to the heater. The simple recuperated cycle of the plant's first phase has one recuperator and the recompression cycle of the second has high- and low-temperature stages, the exchange of equipment and repiping being itself part of the test. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 工程檔案：渦輪進口的設計溫度為 715 °C
steps.observationEn: Project file: Design turbine inlet temperature is 715 °C
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「氣體通過渦輪機之後就變冷了。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在流程圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Gas is cold once it has passed through a turbine." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your flow diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 流程圖標明「渦輪排氣溫度與回熱的必要」的輸入、轉換、損失與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

quiz.question: 依「渦輪排氣溫度與回熱的必要」的模型 T₂ = T₁·r^(−(γ−1)/γ)，進口 715 °C、壓力比 3、比熱比 1.29 時渦輪機的理想排氣溫度（理想氣體近似）最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model T₂ = T₁·r^(−(γ−1)/γ) for "Turbine exhaust temperature and the need to recuperate", which value is closest to the ideal turbine exhaust temperature for a 715 °C inlet, pressure ratio 3 and a heat-capacity ratio of 1.29 (ideal-gas approximation)?
quiz.explanation: T₂ = T₁·r^(−(γ−1)/γ)；代入 T1 = 715 °C、r = 3，得 499 °C（進口 715 °C、壓力比 3、比熱比 1.29 時渦輪機的理想排氣溫度（理想氣體近似））。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: T₂ = T₁·r^(−(γ−1)/γ); with T1 = 715 °C, r = 3 the result is 499 °C (ideal turbine exhaust temperature for a 715 °C inlet, pressure ratio 3 and a heat-capacity ratio of 1.29 (ideal-gas approximation)). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 渦輪排氣溫度與回熱的必要：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Turbine exhaust temperature and the need to recuperate: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「渦輪排氣溫度與回熱的必要」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Turbine exhaust temperature and the need to recuperate” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：T₂ = T₁·r^(−(γ−1)/γ)；代入 T1 = 715 °C、r = 3，得 499 °C（進口 715 °C、壓力比 3、比熱比 1.29 時渦輪機的理想排氣溫度（理想氣體近似））。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 r 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: T₂ = T₁·r^(−(γ−1)/γ); with T1 = 715 °C, r = 3 the result is 499 °C (ideal turbine exhaust temperature for a 715 °C inlet, pressure ratio 3 and a heat-capacity ratio of 1.29 (ideal-gas approximation)). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise r by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：r 增加 10% 時，結果變為 482 °C（-3.3%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising r by 10% changes the result to 482 °C (-3.3%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 499 °C（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 r 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 499 °C (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in r with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: T₂ = T₁·r^(−(γ−1)/γ)；代入 T1 = 715 °C、r = 3，得 499 °C（進口 715 °C、壓力比 3、比熱比 1.29 時渦輪機的理想排氣溫度（理想氣體近似））。
knowledge.textEn: T₂ = T₁·r^(−(γ−1)/γ); with T1 = 715 °C, r = 3 the result is 499 °C (ideal turbine exhaust temperature for a 715 °C inlet, pressure ratio 3 and a heat-capacity ratio of 1.29 (ideal-gas approximation)).

knowledge.title: 敏感度
knowledge.text: r 增加 10% 時，結果變為 482 °C（-3.3%）。 先預測方向與次方，再用計算確認。
knowledge.textEn: Raising r by 10% changes the result to 482 °C (-3.3%). Predict direction and exponent first, then confirm by calculation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為公開標稱值或教學假設的簡化；套用到實際設備前，必須依規範、製造商資料與現場量測重新計算。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are public nominal values or simplified teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, recalculate with codes, manufacturer data and site measurements.

quiz.question: 要驗證「渦輪排氣溫度與回熱的必要」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Turbine exhaust temperature and the need to recuperate"?
options: 沿用另一座電廠或另一台機組的試驗結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
量測渦輪機進出口的溫度與壓力，計算等熵效率並與設計值及理想排氣溫度比較。
密封做得夠好，就可以完全不漏。
optionsEn: Reusing test results from another plant or unit counts as verifying this project.
Temperature and pressure at turbine inlet and outlet give isentropic efficiency for comparison with design and with ideal exhaust temperature.
A seal made well enough leaks nothing.
quiz.explanation: 量測渦輪機進出口的溫度與壓力，計算等熵效率並與設計值及理想排氣溫度比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Temperature and pressure at turbine inlet and outlet give isentropic efficiency for comparison with design and with ideal exhaust temperature. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 渦輪排氣溫度與回熱的必要：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Turbine exhaust temperature and the need to recuperate: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「渦輪排氣溫度與回熱的必要」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Turbine exhaust temperature and the need to recuperate” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 量測渦輪機進出口的溫度與壓力，計算等熵效率並與設計值及理想排氣溫度比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Temperature and pressure at turbine inlet and outlet give isentropic efficiency for comparison with design and with ideal exhaust temperature. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：回熱器的高溫端要依渦輪排氣的溫度與變化速率選材與設計，啟停程序須限制溫度的變化率。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Choose material and design for the hot end of the recuperator from turbine exhaust temperature and its rate of change, limiting that rate in start and stop procedures.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：回熱器高溫側的進口直接承受渦輪排氣的溫度變化；啟停時溫度變化太快，擴散接合的板片因熱應力而開裂。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: The hot inlet of the recuperator takes turbine exhaust temperature swings directly, and when they are too fast at start and stop, diffusion-bonded plates crack from thermal stress. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

optionsEn: Widening the alarm thresholds resolves most anomalies.
Problems of a demonstration unit only get worse at scale.
The hot inlet of the recuperator takes turbine exhaust temperature swings directly, and when they are too fast at start and stop, diffusion-bonded plates crack from thermal stress.

steps.title: 渦輪排氣溫度與回熱的必要：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Turbine exhaust temperature and the need to recuperate: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「渦輪排氣溫度與回熱的必要」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or degradation causes of “Turbine exhaust temperature and the need to recuperate” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 回熱器高溫側的進口直接承受渦輪排氣的溫度變化；啟停時溫度變化太快，擴散接合的板片因熱應力而開裂。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢查，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響「STEP 超臨界二氧化碳示範電廠」的安全、出力、壽命或併網。
steps.instructionEn: The hot inlet of the recuperator takes turbine exhaust temperature swings directly, and when they are too fast at start and stop, diffusion-bonded plates crack from thermal stress. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects safety, output, life or grid connection of “STEP Supercritical CO2 Demonstration Plant”.
steps.observation: 連結機制：示範廠第一階段的簡單回熱循環只有一級回熱器，第二階段的再壓縮循環則有高溫與低溫兩級——設備的更換與重新配管，本身就是試驗的一部分。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The simple recuperated cycle of the plant's first phase has one recuperator and the recompression cycle of the second has high- and low-temperature stages, the exchange of equipment and repiping being itself part of the test.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「氣體通過渦輪機之後就變冷了。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Gas is cold once it has passed through a turbine." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢查能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.
